decisions.decision: Prefer existing reviewed tools and evaluation frameworks over bespoke replacements.
decisions.reason: Reduce duplicated engineering and improve reproducibility, provenance, maintenance, and cost.

decisions.decision: Treat first six-question capability benchmark as measured failure, not emergence or AGI.
decisions.reason: Both small open-weight models scored zero correct; benchmark was tiny and nonstandard.

decisions.decision: Retain bounded deterministic solvers for tasks they can directly verify.
decisions.reason: Avoid unnecessary language model inference where approved tools already suffice.

decisions.decision: Do not publish private founder source documents in public research-memory.
decisions.reason: The repository and its evidence ledger are public; confidential memoranda require private controls.

decisions.decision: Preserve append-only experiment archives; separately update concise strategic state.
decisions.reason: A durable project ledger must link original failed and successful runs while making current objectives easy to resume.

decisions.decision: Do not promote the Qwen3-4B model on the initial six-question comparison.
decisions.reason: Independent audit recorded 2/6 versus Qwen3-1.7B at 1/6, no gain from verification prompting, no program-synthesis successes and ~1.8x baseline model seconds. Larger unseen tests are required.

decisions.decision: Use upstream Inspect AI rather than build another general-purpose evaluation framework.
decisions.reason: Pinned open-source v0.3.287 framework executed and independently scored a positive and negative public replay in CI run 42336662799, without model/API inference. Full multi-domain capability verification remains necessary.

decisions.decision: Adopt pinned OpenHands SDK and PaperQA2 rather than rebuild agent coding and paper QA frameworks.
decisions.reason: Separate real upstream import checks passed CI run 42339003588 with zero model calls. Real agent code and citation performance remain unmeasured and need controlled experiments.

decisions.decision: Do not promote PaperQA2 to a reliable scientific research answerer on current data.
decisions.reason: Real offline public source retrieval scored 1/2 top-1 questions (run 42340104253); import and workflow success do not establish accurate citation or scientific reasoning. Preserve errors and require new heldout evaluation.

decisions.decision: Preserve first actual Inspect ARC run as a measured failed configuration, not a general model verdict.
decisions.reason: Original independently scored 0/24 with 48-token Qwen reasoning preamble and a separate custom task-ID audit error; official raw results are immutable for comparison.

decisions.decision: Upgrade OpenHands assessment from SDK imports to actual controlled tool functionality only.
decisions.reason: Real editor create/repair/deny evidence passed GitHub run 42340592716; intrinsic code-generation capability remains unmeasured until a restricted model-driven pilot.

decisions.decision: Do not promote PaperQA sparse dimension 4096 on an exploratory eight-question comparison.
decisions.reason: Original public retrieval was 1/2; after inspecting its miss, upstream sparse-embedding settings scored 5/8 versus 6/8 on new but related queries. This is insufficient independent evidence of reliable retrieval gains.

decisions.decision: Retain proven non-thinking response configuration for short exact-answer Qwen3-0.6B ARC tasks, without model promotion.
decisions.reason: Official original Inspect scorer: prior thinking-on 0/24 all failed format versus non-thinking 17/24 (ARC Easy 9/12; Challenge 8/12), 0 invalid format cases, same model/checkpoint and task sample. Difference is task-response configuration; no model learning established.

decisions.decision: Expand from two ARC science families to four previously established third-party Inspect Evals task families on a fixed 96-item public benchmark.
decisions.reason: The verified 17/24 initial ARC result only tested narrow school science; using published existing GSM8K, HellaSwag and MMLU permits broader independent scoring without reimplementing evaluator infrastructure. Small published tests may be contaminated, and are not unseen generalization or AGI.

decisions.decision: Retain the original GSM8K 128-token baseline; archive the exploratory 256-token variant without changing model weights or promoting it.
decisions.reason: Controlled official GSM8K study showed only 6/24 -> 7/24 on the same questions, with two repairs and one regression. Increased generation allowance did not establish a reliable reasoning improvement.

decisions.decision: Do not promote Qwen3-1.7B on the tiny public 48-question comparison; archive recovered official grades, all per-example regressions and original model outputs.
decisions.reason: 21/48 versus 18/48 was accompanied by five regressions, especially GSM8K 1/12 versus 4/12. The larger model hit the 128-token cap on 10/12 math questions; more data and controlled evaluation needed.

decisions.decision: Reuse official Inspect HumanEval original functional scorer and Docker isolation rather than creating a custom coding benchmark.
decisions.reason: Current verified Plenum OpenHands editor operation is not an autonomous code-generation result. Test actual model-written code using 3 original official independent tests before selecting a larger agent framework or model; this cannot prove general intelligence.

decisions.decision: Prioritize a fair original functional coding/agent test over new model training; change model output budget before assuming low math accuracy reflects reasoning deficiency.
decisions.reason: On 12 matched public Qwen3-1.7B GSM8K questions, independently scored 256 tokens improved 1/12 to 7/12 compared with 128 tokens (six repairs, no regressions, all fixed earlier cap-hits). This is a meaningful format confound and cannot establish AGI.

decisions.decision: Advance from original one-shot executable coding evaluation to existing Inspect ReAct agent, without a homegrown agent loop.
decisions.reason: First independently scored Qwen3-1.7B HumanEval study produced two passing out of three original sandboxed function tests and archived one failure. A separate bounded agent with real tool-call transcripts and original scoring is needed before any autonomy claim.

operating_rules: On every status/resume request, fetch the latest state and append-only evidence from research-memory before advising.
Label scheduled, implemented, experimentally confirmed, and failed work distinctly.
Never infer scientific novelty or general intelligence from generated language or green CI.
Do not auto-publish private content or authorize spending, model promotion, external communication, or unrestricted code execution.
Update this public-safe status after important verified experiments and decisions, preserving previous evidence URLs.
